$comment: Settings for the documentation token-usage experiment. Paths are relative to research-work/.
$isolateComment: Copy each arm folder into <workspaceRoot>/<label>/<folder> (outside the repo, own git init, no node_modules) so doc paths resolve against the arm root. Keep workspaceRoot out of the system temp dir.
promptSuffix: This is a read-only question: do not create or modify any files. Give a concise answer that names the specific files, functions, and values involved.
$aliasesComment: Run folders created before the v1 rename used the old arm IDs; analyze.mjs maps them with armAliases.
